description: On the table there’s an open black case, a small gray oval item, and a small tan-and-white piece sitting near the case. The right hand reaches forward to pick up the tan-and-white piece and places it into the open case, then grabs the gray oval item and puts it inside as well; after that, the right hand lowers the lid to close the case while the left hand stays nearby and then lightly steadies the case as the right hand finishes closing and releases it.
